data.description:
## Purpose

This ticket is the mechanism-ratchet admission for `[verify] plan_review_engine`. That setting is permanent and first-class: both plan-review engines, the 4-pass pipeline and the single read-only agent, stay supported, and the setting chooses between them. This was decided by the operator on 2026-11-12 and is recorded in ADR 0123 (`docs/adr/0123-selectable-plan-review-engine.md`).

The repo has one convention for admitting a mechanism added after the baseline froze (`docs/architecture.md` §"Mechanism-delta ratchet"; `src/rebar/_commands/sunset_markers.py`). Contributors never hand-edit `.github/mechanism-baseline.json`. Instead, a `# mechanism-ok:` marker at the definition site names a ticket, and rebar refuses to close that ticket while the marker remains. The marker for this setting, at `src/rebar/_config_sections.py`, names this ticket.

## Lifecycle

- This ticket stays `open` and unclaimed as long as `verify.plan_review_engine` exists. Do not work it and do not close it.
- It closes only if a future operator decision removes the setting. The change that removes the setting deletes the marker in the same commit and runs `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale`. This ticket then closes as completed.
- It is not a child of epic `pompous-vitriolic-macaw`, so that epic can close while this ticket stays open.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] [non-codebase] An operator decision to remove `[verify] plan_review_engine` is recorded in a comment on this ticket.
- [ ] `git grep -nF plan_review_engine -- src rebar.toml docs/config.md` prints nothing.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exits 0.
data.title: Keep the plan-review engine setting admitted (permanent; stays open while the setting exists)
